# DevWright

> DevWright is a free, browser-only collection of developer utilities. Every tool runs entirely client-side — nothing pasted into a tool is ever uploaded or sent to a server. No account, signup, or file upload is required.

## Tools

- [Code Formatter](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/code-formatter.html): Format, minify, and validate JSON, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS.
- [YAML ⇄ JSON Converter](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/yaml-json.html): Convert between YAML and JSON instantly.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/base64-tool.html): Encode or decode Base64 text.
- [URL Encoder & Decoder](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/url-encoder.html): Percent-encode or decode URLs.
- [JWT Decoder](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/jwt-decoder.html): Decode a JWT's header and payload.
- [Hash Generator](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/hash-generator.html): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 hashes of any text.
- [UUID / ULID Generator](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/uuid-generator.html): Generate UUID v4 or ULID identifiers in bulk.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/unix-timestamp.html): Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and back.
- [Color Converter](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/color-converter.html): Convert colors between HEX, RGB, and HSL.
- [Curl to Code Converter](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/curl-converter.html): Convert a curl command into Python, JavaScript, Node.js, PHP, Go, Java, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, or Rust code.
- [Regex Tester](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/regex-tester.html): Test regular expressions against sample text with live match highlighting.

## Languages

DevWright's homepage is available in four languages, each at its own URL:

- [English](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/)
- [한국어](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/ko/)
- [日本語](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/ja/)
- [中文](https://dev-joohyun.github.io/devwright/zh/)

## Notes

- All processing happens locally in the browser using standard Web APIs; no user input is ever transmitted to a server.
- The site has no build step and no backend — every page is a self-contained static HTML file.
